info.title: FleetOps Feature 001 — Vehicle Registration
info.description: Planning-only contract for AUTH-01/02, FLT-01 and DEV-008. The user-authorized integration.idempotency_keys addition and post-trim UTF-16 code-unit rules resolve B-001/B-002. No API implementation or runtime validation is claimed.

x-review-status: REVISED FOR REVIEW: B-001/B-002 resolved by user direction; implementation and runtime evidence pending

get.summary: List the verified user's active carrier memberships and effective capabilities
get.description: Verified provider credentials and current session state are required. Results are obtained by a bounded identity bootstrap interface and contain only this user's active memberships. No client subject/role/organization claim grants membership. This operation does not require a selected carrier.

get.summary: Read vehicles in the verified selected carrier
get.description: Requires fleet.vehicle.read. Exact unit-number filtering trims outer whitespace and applies the same case-insensitive collation as uniqueness. No foreign-carrier counts or rows. Default limit 50, maximum 100; cursor bound to user, carrier, filters and sort order.

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.description: Optional exact normalized unit number; same post-trim UTF-16 validation as registration.

schema.description: Exact normalized unit-number search value. Validate well-formed Unicode, trim the fixed ECMAScript whitespace set, then require 1–30 UTF-16 code units. Supplementary characters count as two. No truncation or Unicode normalization. The custom annotations require explicit client/server validators; generic maxLength is intentionally omitted.

post.summary: Register a truck for the verified selected carrier
post.description: Requires current fleet.vehicle.read and fleet.vehicle.create. Scope Idempotency-Key by verified tenant, operation version and submitting membership. A transaction-owned SQL lock serializes that scope; asset, vehicle, audit and integration.idempotency_keys receipt commit together. Authorized identical canonical payload/key retries return the original 201 body and Location after restart with no new effect. A different valid canonical payload conflicts with 409; invalid input is 422. Another member/tenant's raw key never retrieves the original result. Reauthorize after waiting and before replay. Replay uses hash-verified original input and immutable referenced vehicle identity/creation time, not mutable current values. No automatic receipt expiry/purge. Unknown body fields including tenant_id/role/asset_id/status are rejected after authorization.

201.description: Committed registration or currently authorized replay with identical original JSON values and Location; no new audit on replay.

Location.description: Relative authorized vehicle detail API path

get.description: Requires fleet.vehicle.read. Resolve vehicle ID within verified tenant and join asset by tenant_id plus asset_id. An unknown vehicle and another carrier's vehicle use identical non-disclosing 404 payloads apart from request_id.

SessionBearer.description: Official provider verification plus current session status, then internal membership/capability checks. Production rejects synthetic test issuers.

TenantSelection.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantSelection.description: User's carrier selection only; server must verify active membership before binding SQL scope. Missing/unverified selection is forbidden. Never ownership authority by itself.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID submission key, canonicalized to lowercase hyphenated form and scoped to verified tenant, vehicle.register:v1 and submitting membership. Retain unchanged across uncertain-response retries; no automatic expiration in Feature 001. Valid changed payload under the same scope/key returns 409.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque authenticated cursor bound to verified identity/context and filters; invalid or changed-context cursor rejected with 422.

created_at.description: Original immutable fleet.vehicles.created_at in UTC, serialized with exactly three fractional digits and Z; identical on replay.

permissions.description: Feature-relevant current permissions, not client-supplied roles

message.description: Safe user-facing message without SQL/provider internals or foreign-carrier details.

Forbidden.description: Known forbidden capability, inactive membership or missing/unverified carrier context (403).

ValidationFailed.description: Safe field/header/query validation failure; no business writes (422).

NotFound.description: Unknown or non-disclosable vehicle; same response semantics (404).

Conflict.description: Duplicate normalized unit or conflicting idempotency payload; no extra truck (409).

InternalError.description: Sanitized internal error; unfinished transaction rolls back (500).

Unavailable.description: Identity/session verification or service unavailable; fail closed with no claimed success (503).
